rebaselineReasons: The 2026-10-16 re-review repair restores plural and gerund echoes using noun/verb chunk context and singleton lemmas, without reintroducing the ambiguous-reading negative fixtures. Precision stays 1.0 and all far controls stay zero; individual echo injections now have 100% recall in both splits.

The prior 43/58 dev and 48/61 test echo floors are replaced by 57/58 and 60/61. The only remaining misses are natural-copy targets inside tokenizer compounds: low-arched versus Arched in moby-005-natural and sun-toasted versus Toasted in moby-023-natural. The generator selects regex subwords while the product keeps each compound as one word. Frozen gold remains unchanged, and natural-copy floors stay 25/26; the previous quote-turn explanation was incorrect.
The 30-word cap, same-sentence short-pair suppression and quote-turn suppression remain owner decisions. Near injection range and gold counts are unchanged from b113df7.

Repeated-phrase in-scope cases retain 100% precision/recall, with distant two-use pairs scored as negative controls; punctuation, abbreviation, frequent-shorter and name-fallback fixtures are covered in Rust.
